rows.text: To mimic the survival methods of the leviathans, the Diners of the Feeder's Guild voluntarily integrated into a larger entity, becoming a mouth sharing the scraps. They scoured the cosmos to find the perfect vessel to possess: Void song whales, depth crawlers, and even ancient amoebas... none could satisfy that craving. Using leftover technology from the Borderstar Trade War era, the Diners finally achieved their ultimate wish by fusing themselves together. Countless mouths slaughtered and competed on the surface of this composite lifeform, and even devouring planets along its path couldn't satiate its hunger. After destroying the aggregate entity, the IPC convicted it of crimes against humanity, until the School of Relative Cognition offered a more humanistic perspective: "At least they provided their victims with freedom: the freedom to choose the mouth that eats them."
